title: Encoding
description: Learn Base64 and UTF-8 encoding. Understand how text is converted to Base64 strings and how characters are represented as UTF-8 byte sequences.
example_base64_3_desc: Decode the Base64 value 'RklY' (third letter is lowercase L).
example_utf8_2_desc: The Unicode character Myanmar Shan Digit Zero has code point U+1090. Convert it to its UTF-8 binary representation.
example_utf8_3_desc: Which Unicode character is encoded by the UTF-8 binary sequence 1110 0001 1010 0000 1010 0000?
